summary.text: Dustyn Dorn is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Abby Major.

An information technology professional from Rochester, Pennsylvania, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running on government transparency, protecting vulnerable residents and affordable health care.

paragraphs.text: Dustyn Dorn earned a high school diploma from Rochester High School and an associate degree from the Pittsburgh Technical Institute in 2004, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his career experience as working as an information technology professional.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Rochester in Beaver County, worked in IT for various industries before joining the Bank of New York, where he rose from an entry-level position to people leader and service manager, and is a licensed PIAA football referee.

Dorn said his campaign emphasizes restoring trust in state government through term limits, independent redistricting, and stronger gift and reporting laws, along with well-funded public schools and good-paying jobs.

He listed affordable health care, mental health services, protection of public lands and waterways, and responsible economic development among his policy interests, and named the Pennsylvania AFL-CIO, the Pennsylvania Sierra Club and several labor organizations as endorsers.
